theater: 河北大名府澶州白馬津渡口

battle.name: 澶州之戰
battle.theater: 河北大名府澶州白馬津渡口
battle.brief: 景德元年（1004）冬，遼軍南下抵黃河北岸，宋真宗自開封親征至澶州，兩軍隔河列營相持，主戰與主和兩派在幕中角力。卡面的宋制霹靂砲位在宋軍遠程火力末端，以爆炸作用打擊城壘與器械，與砲石、弓弩並用；澶州兵器記載有限，但同年貝州方向的攻城序列已見火藥器具與砲石同列。

kit.name: 霹靂火砲
kit.history: 霹靂砲位於宋代遠程火力體系，以爆炸作用攻擊城防、人員與器材，通常配置於攻城或守城陣列，與弓弩及砲石相互配合。

countries: 一〇〇四年冬天，戰場落在宋遼兩國最靠近的一段邊界上：大名府所屬的澶州（今河南濮陽），以及黃河南北兩岸相望的渡口帶。交戰的一方是遼國，由聖宗耶律隆緒統兵，而軍國大事出於其母蕭氏之手；這位攝政的蕭氏自太平興國年間用兵以來，便一直是遼國決策的核心，澶州大營裡的每一道令，仍然經她與聖宗商定。遼軍以契丹騎兵為骨干，配以漢軍、渤海軍與奚、靼諸部，攻城則倚重固定的攻城營具；後勤倚中京一線的草場、馬群與河道轉運，人馬自備乾糧，卻需要大量車帳隨行。另一方是北宋：真宗趙恆自開封帶禁軍與河北諸路勤王之師北上，宰相寇準力主並主持親征，中書執政王曾等同在幕府；宋軍以步軍為主、禁軍拱衛，行軍依賴汴河與黃河的水運，糧秣自河南一路北運，河北諸城則屯有守軍與城防器械。雙方在澶州相持，考的不是一城一地，而是黃河渡口能不能守住，誰先把糧道耗斷。
countriesEn: The winter campaign of 1004 was fought on the closest stretch of the Song-Liao frontier: Chanzhou, a prefecture belonging to Daming Circuit in Hebei, now Puyang in Henan, together with the belt of Yellow River fords on either side of the water. One belligerent was the Liao, whose army was nominally under the command of Emperor Shengzong, Yelü Longxu, while the decisions of state were made by his mother, the regent of the Xiao clan, who had directed Liao policy since the campaigns of the Taiping Xingguo years and who, even in the great camp at Chanzhou, still settled every order jointly with her son. Liao's strength lay in Khitan cavalry, supported by Han, Bohai and Xi or Gesar contingents, with siege trains carried along for attacks on walled towns; its supply rested on the pastures and horse herds of the Central Capital region and on river transport, each rider carrying his own dry rations while the column as a whole still needed wagons and tents. The other side was the Song. Emperor Zhenzong, Zhao Heng, marched north out of Kaifeng with the imperial guard and the reinforcements of the Hebei circuits; the chancellor Kou Zhun pressed for and directed the personal campaign, with the other central secretary Wang Zeng beside him in the command. The Song army was infantry-based with the guard troops at its core, marched on the Bian and Yellow Rivers for its grain, and had garrisons and fortification equipment in the Hebei towns. What was decided at Chanzhou was not the fate of any single city, but whether the river crossings could be held and whose supply line would break first.
people: 留下了姓名的，多半在宋廷一邊。真宗趙恆是這場戰爭的當事人：景德元年八月，寇準與王曾等力主親征，把主張南遷的方案壓了下去，軍隊遂自開封北上，同年十月抵達澶州一線。寇準是此役最關鍵的人物，他不只反對遷都，也反對倉促開戰，主張深溝高壘、以逸待勞，等遼軍糧盡自退；澶州城下遼軍逼近時，他力請真宗登城督戰，穩住三軍。主張南遷的一派以王欽若為首，陳堯叟、張泊等附議，事後多因此受到貶斥。楊億以中書舍人之筆寫下《澶州之戰》一文，記下「三鼓之聲」那段軍心震動的場面。議和的過程則由曹利用、宋若水一輩的使者承擔，曹利用在遼營中把條件壓到歲輸銀十萬兩、絹二十萬匹的水準。遼方主角是聖宗耶律隆緒與攝政的蕭氏，統軍將領在《遼史》中多以「北院都統」「南院統軍」等職名出現，具體人名反而不見。同一時間，宋軍的另一支正在貝州（今河北清河）攻城，與澶州一線互為犄角，該路主將的姓名在各史傳中也都殘缺。
peopleEn: Those whose names survive are mostly on the Song side. Emperor Zhenzong, Zhao Heng, was the principal party to the war. In the eighth month of the Jingde era (1004) Kou Zhun and Wang Zeng carried the personal campaign, beating back the proposals for moving the court south, and the army set out from Kaifeng in the north, reaching the Chanzhou line in the tenth month of the same year. Kou Zhun was the decisive figure of the engagement: he opposed not only the flight of the court but also a premature general action, and advocated digging deep entrenchments and holding the fort, waiting for the Liao army to wear out and withdraw for want of grain. When the Liao came close to the city below Chanzhou, he pressed the emperor to climb the wall and show himself, and that steadied the army. The party favouring a move south was led by Wang Qinruo, with Chen Yaosou and Zhang Bo in agreement, and most of them were demoted afterwards for it. Yang Yi, a secretary of the central secretariat, wrote the piece known as the Account of the Battle of Chanzhou, preserving the passage about the three beats of the drum that shook the morale of the host. The negotiation was carried by envoys of the calibre of Cao Liyong and Song Ruoshui; in the Liao camp Cao Liyong pressed the terms down to a yearly payment of one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk. On the Liao side the principals were Emperor Shengzong, Yelü Longxu, and the regent of the Xiao clan; the commanders appear in the History of Liao mostly under office titles such as commander of the Northern Administration and commander of the Southern Administration, and personal names are scarce. At the same time another Song column was besieging Beizhou, now Qinghe in Hebei, in support of the Chanzhou line, and the name of its commander is likewise missing from the histories.
kits: 卡面所示的宋制霹靂砲，是北宋遠程火力序列末端的一件兵器：以爆炸作用打擊城壘、人馬與器械，通常隨砲石與弓弩一同配置，而不是獨當一面。關於它在澶州會戰中的具體使用，史料留下的筆墨很有限——《宋史》記景德元年河北戰事，多寫軍令、行軍與議和，很少細記兵器；同年宋軍圍攻貝州的記載裡，才見到攻城序列中砲石與火藥器具同列的痕跡。可以確定的是，宋廷在北方防線上已把火藥武器列入配備，而《武經總要》所載的霹靂火藥之制，正是這一時期火藥技術的整理成果。宋軍的火力骨干是弓弩：各式步弓與強弩（後來在《武經總要》中以神臂弓之名著錄）構成射擊群，砲石用於壓制城牆、營壘與水壘，霹靂砲一類的爆炸投射物則用於破壞固定目標；步軍披札甲、持長槊與藤牌，騎兵配弓箭與環首刀。攻城時備有撞車、雲梯、望樓與穴地用的鎬斧，防守方靠城郭、拒馬與陷坑。運輸全靠車營、牛驢與河運；遼軍則以馬群自帶乾糧，攻城營具仿自中原樣式，兩軍在器物上的差距，多半就落在火藥這一項上。
kitsEn: The Song thunder-crash bomb shown on the card is the last item in the Song line of long-range firepower: a projected charge that works by explosion against walls, men, horses and equipment, normally emplaced together with stone throwers, bows and crossbows rather than used on its own. The record of its actual employment at Chanzhou is thin. The History of Song describes the Hebei fighting of the Jingde era mostly in terms of orders, marches and negotiations, and rarely itemises weapons; it is in the account of the Song siege of Beizhou in the same year that stone-throwers and powder-filled devices appear together in the assault column. What can be established is that the Song court had already counted powder weapons among the equipment of the northern frontier, and that the forms of thunder-crash powder recorded in the Wujing Zongyao are the codification of exactly this period's technology. The backbone of Song firepower was the bow and crossbow: various infantry bows and strong crossbows, the latter later recorded in the Wujing Zongyao under the name of the divine-arm crossbow, made up the shooting groups; stone throwers were used to pin walls, camps and stockades; explosive projectiles of the thunder-crash type were used against fixed targets. Foot soldiers wore lamellar armour and carried long spears and rattan shields, cavalry were armed with bows and ring-pommel swords. For attack they brought battering rams, scaling ladders, watch towers and picks and mattocks for tunnelling, while the defenders relied on walls, chevaux-de-frise and pits. Everything moved on wagon laagers, oxen, mules and river transport; the Liao army lived on the grain its horses carried, and its siege gear was copied from Chinese models, so the difference between the two armies in materiel came down, for the most part, to the powder.
tactics: 澶州一帶的戰術，圍繞黃河那道天險展開。澶州州城在黃河南岸，宋真宗的御營與主力大營佈在北岸的白馬津一線，遼軍自北方壓來，必須先渡河才能接近宋軍；初冬水量枯減，渡口可通而受限，遼軍無法像在平原上那樣展開全部兵力。宋廷的處置相當克制：寇準反對在士氣未振時與遼軍決戰，主張列營深溝高壘，閉門不戰，只以弓弩與砲石壓制對方營壘，等其糧道拉長、人馬疲敝。所謂「三鼓之聲」正是這種戰法下的士氣來源——真宗親臨前線，軍中呼聲震天，遼軍望而不敢輕進。遼軍則照舊用老辦法：分兵插入宋境各城，圍點打援，同時以大隊騎兵在黃河兩岸游弋，尋找薄弱之處；一旦宋軍主力被釘在澶州，便派偏師繞道南下，試探宋軍的後方與糧道。宋軍的補給線長度是致命弱點：自開封經汴河、黃河到澶州，數百里水陸接運，冬天水淺轉運遲緩，一次小小的潰退就足以拖垮整條線。雙方因此都打成一場耐力賽，比的是誰能在冬日的河邊多撐幾十天。
tacticsEn: The tactics at Chanzhou turned on the Yellow River as a natural barrier. The walled seat of the prefecture lay on the south bank, while the emperor's encampment and the main army of the Song were deployed along Baima Ford on the north bank; the Liao, pressing down from the north, had to cross the river before it could close with the Song, and with the water low in early winter the fords were passable but restricted, so the Liao could not deploy its full strength as it might on open ground. The Song court was notably restrained in its handling of the situation. Kou Zhun opposed seeking a decision while the morale of the host was still unsteady; he argued for deep entrenchments and fortified camps, for refusing battle, and for pressing the enemy encampments with nothing but arrows, crossbow bolts and stone, so that the Liao lines of supply would stretch and its men and horses would tire. The so-called three beats of the drum were precisely the source of morale under this method: the emperor in person at the front, the cry of the host shaking the air, and the Liao unwilling to advance rashly after seeing it. The Liao kept to its old methods. It sent separate columns into the Song towns, besieging one point to draw another, while masses of cavalry patrolled both banks of the river in search of weak places; once the Song main force was pinned at Chanzhou, it sent flanking columns round to the south to test the Song rear and its supply road. The length of the Song supply line was the fatal weakness: from Kaifeng by the Bian and the Yellow River to Chanzhou, several hundred li of water and land transport, slow in winter when the shallows shoaled, and a small reverse could drag the whole line down. Both sides were therefore running an endurance contest, to see who could hold out longest on the winter river.
data: 可以核的數字不多，但有幾項相當硬。和議的價碼是：宋每年向遼納銀十萬兩、絹二十萬匹，兩國以兄弟相稱，宋稱弟，並在白馬澶州互派使臣；此後宋廷因形勢所需，一度把歲幣加到銀二十萬兩、絹三十萬匹，一加就是四成，說明這筆開支的重量。時間上，遼軍自咸平六年（1003）冬南下，景德元年（1004）八月宋廷議定親征，同年十月大軍抵澶州，十一月到十二月雙方在黃河兩岸對峙，和議在景德二年（1005）正月落定，前後拖了一年多。地名距離上，澶州在今河南濮陽，離開封約二百公里，御營與州城隔河相望；白馬津在州城東北，遼軍營壘在河北岸。就兵力而言，兩朝的記載都以概數說話，遼軍常被寫成十萬乃至二十萬之眾，宋軍則是禁軍加河北諸路勤王之師，同樣有以十萬為量級的說法流傳；這些都當作量級看待，不能當作統計。損傷、俘獲與耗糧則無從核實；能估的只有開支：銀十萬兩、絹二十萬匹按當年價折約合市錢百餘萬，那筆錢全部出自宋廷的歲入。
dataEn: The arithmetic that survives is not large, but a few items are hard. The price of the settlement was this: the Song would pay the Liao one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk every year; the two states would be brother and brother, with the Song taking the younger place; and envoys would be exchanged at Baima Ford by Chanzhou. Later, pressed by circumstances, the Song court raised the annual payment once more to two hundred thousand taels of silver and three hundred thousand bolts of silk, an increase of two fifths, which tells you how heavy the item had become. In time: the Liao moved south in the winter of the sixth year of the Xianping era (1003); in the eighth month of the first year of the Jingde era (1004) the Song court settled on the personal campaign; the main army reached Chanzhou in the tenth month of the same year; the two sides stood facing each other across the river through the eleventh and twelfth months; and the settlement was concluded in the first month of the second year of Jingde (1005), after a war that had run for more than a year. In place and distance: Chanzhou is today's Puyang in Henan, some two hundred kilometres from Kaifeng, the imperial camp and the prefectural town facing each other across the water, with Baima Ford to the north-east of the town and the Liao encampments on the northern bank. As to numbers of men, both courts speak in round figures; the Liao host is commonly written up as one hundred thousand or even two hundred thousand, and the Song force, the imperial guard plus the reinforcements of the Hebei circuits, circulates in statements of the same order of magnitude. These should be read as orders of magnitude, not as statistics. Losses, prisoners and consumption of grain cannot be verified at all; what can be estimated is the outlay, the silver and silk of the treaty summing, at the prices of the day, to rather more than a million cash, all of it taken out of the Song's revenue.
cause: 打起來的緣由分三層。最外一層是眼前的：景德元年之前，遼遣使到宋廷重議盟好條件，內容包括關南地界與歲幣數目，宋廷沒有答應，蕭氏便趁宋廷新君初立、河北諸路兵備空虛之際，舉國南下。往裡一層是遼自身的算盤：燕雲十六州自雍熙北伐失敗後一直在遼人手中，蕭氏與聖宗並不打算放棄，卻也明白宋廷每一次北伐都指著燕雲；趁宋廷無力，遼可以迫使中原再出一筆錢，順帶在河北各城製造壓力，迫宋廷認下既成的事實。更深的一層是宋廷自己的軟弱：真宗即位之後，朝中主和派與主戰派爭執不休，河北城防的修補、軍額的補充與糧運的準備都沒有完成，一旦開戰，宋廷只能靠宮廷意志與士氣硬撐。於是整場戰爭的邏輯很簡單：遼用騎兵與快馬把戰火推到黃河下游，宋用真宗親臨這一招把士氣提起來，兩邊都在賭，賭對方先撐不住。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason for the fighting. The outermost was immediate: before the Jingde era the Liao sent envoys to the Song court to renegotiate the terms of their compact, including the line of the frontier south of the passes and the size of the annual payments; the Song court would not agree, and the regent of the Xiao clan took advantage of a Song newly come to the throne and of the empty condition of the Hebei circuits to bring the whole army south. A layer deeper was the Liao's own arithmetic. The sixteen prefectures of Yan and Yun had been in Liao hands since the failed Northern Expedition of the Yongxi era, and neither the regent nor Shengzong had any intention of giving them up, but they understood as well that every Song expedition north aimed at Yan and Yun. While the Song was weak, the Liao could force the Central Plain to pay out once more, and could at the same time put pressure on the Heberi towns until the Song court accepted the fait accompli. The deepest layer was the Song's own weakness. After Zhenzong took the throne the court argued endlessly between the party for peace and the party for war, and the repair of the Hebei defences, the expansion of the army rolls and the preparation of the grain transport were all left unfinished; once war came, the Song could only hold on through the will of the court and the morale of its troops. The logic of the whole war was therefore simple. The Liao used cavalry and fast horses to push the fighting down to the lower Yellow River; the Song used the emperor's presence at the front to raise its spirits; both were gambling on who would give way first.
impact: 澶州之後，宋遼之間換來了大約四十年的安靜，這是它最直接的效果。景德二年以後，北宋放棄了收復燕雲的念頭，河北的戰線由進攻轉為守禦，國策的重心一路南移到對西夏與西北蕃部的戰事；同一段時間裡，宋廷把省下的心力拿去做別的事：大中祥符年間的天書、封禪泰山、耗資巨大的典禮，一場接一場地辦，寇準因為反對封禪被貶出朝廷。歲幣則成為一筆固定開支，直接壓在財政上，慶曆年間再議加幣時，朝臣的爭執幾乎全落在「再增就是再賄」一句上，爭到最後仍是照加，等到與西夏開戰，河北的錢袋子便同時要在兩個方向上使力。對兵器而言，這段安定期反而是技術整頓的時機：《武經總要》在景德之後數十年問世，把火藥、砲石、弓弩、攻城器械的用法系統整理成書，霹靂火藥的形制由此定型，其後在采石、荊湖一線的攻防中屢見記載。而在外交上，澶州式的解法——用銀與絹換取邊界——也定了調，此後宋對遼、對西夏都沿用同一套算法，直到海上之盟把這筆帳一次清空。
impactEn: After Chanzhou the Song and the Liao bought themselves roughly forty years of quiet, and that was the engagement's most direct effect. From the second year of Jingde the Northern Song gave up the idea of recovering Yan and Yun, the line in Hebei turned from advance to defence, and the weight of policy shifted south to the war against Western Xia and the tribes of the northwest. In those same years the court spent the energy it had saved on other things: the written charms of the Dazhong Xiangfu era, the sacrifice on Mount Tai, and the enormous expense of the ceremonies, one after another, and Kou Zhun was driven out of the capital for opposing the sacrifice. The annual payment became a fixed item of the budget, pressing directly on the finances, and when the question of adding to it came up again in the Qingli years the argument in the court came down almost entirely to the line that to increase it further would be to pay tribute twice over; it was added in the end, and when war with Western Xia began the purse of the north had to be spent in two directions at once. As for weapons, the long peace was in fact a time for technical consolidation: the Wujing Zongyao appeared some decades after Jingde and set down in orderly form the use of powder, stone throwers, bows and crossbows and siege engines, fixing the shape of the thunder-crash powder, which is afterwards recorded again and again in the fighting on the Cai River and in the Jinghu region. In diplomacy too the Chanzhou solution — buying the frontier with silver and silk — set the tone, and the Song used the same arithmetic afterwards with the Liao and with Western Xia, until the maritime alliance of 1122 cleared the account in one stroke.
result: 結果是僵持而不是勝負。景德元年冬至二年春，宋遼兩軍在澶州黃河兩岸相持，遼軍既不能渡河南取，也不能在宋軍的深溝高壘前求得便宜，而宋廷的遠程砲火與糧秣供應同樣不足以支持北伐；雙方都需要一個台階。景德二年正月，蕭氏與聖宗率軍至白馬澶州，與宋真宗所遣的使者會商，議定以兄弟相稱、劃界而處、各守疆界，宋每年納銀十萬兩、絹二十萬匹，雙方在白馬澶州互送使臣；消息傳回開封，朝野稱賀，而寇準力主乘勝追擊、掃清河北的呼聲被壓下。貝州方向的圍攻隨之解除，宋軍退回。對宋真宗而言，這是一場靠錢財與體面換來的政治平手：皇帝親征的膽氣保住了，中原一寸土地卻沒有取回，燕雲的旗影還在北方的天際線上；對蕭氏而言，宋廷的歲幣與宋人的天書一同成了遼國的戰利品。澶州從此成為河北重鎮，靖康年間再成宋金角力的場所，而那時早已無人再提這一年冬季的分寸。
resultEn: The result was a stalemate rather than a victory. From the winter of the first year of Jingde to the spring of the second, the two armies stood facing one another across the Yellow River at Chanzhou. The Liao could neither cross the river to take the south nor gain anything in front of the Song's deep entrenchments, and the Song's long-range artillery and grain supply were equally unequal to a campaign north. Both sides needed a step down. In the first month of the second year of Jingde the regent of the Xiao clan and Shengzong brought their army to Baima Ford by Chanzhou and conferred with the envoys the emperor had sent; it was agreed that the two states would be brothers, that each would keep the frontier line, that the Song would pay one hundred thousand taels of silver and two hundred thousand bolts of silk every year, and that envoys would be exchanged at Baima Ford. The news reached Kaifeng and the court and the capital acclaimed it, while Kou Zhun's call to press the advantage and clear the Hebei plain was talked down. The siege of Beizhou was lifted and the Song withdrew. For Zhenzong this was a political draw bought with money and appearances: the nerve of the emperor's personal campaign was preserved, but not an inch of the Central Plain was recovered, and the banner of Yan and Yun was still on the northern horizon. For the regent of the Xiao clan, the Song's annual payments and the Song's charms from heaven alike became Liao's spoils. Chanzhou from then on was a major town of Hebei, and during the Jingkang era it became a place where Song and Jin disputed each other again, by which time no one remembered the measure kept that winter of 1004.
